Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking this. Nebula is kicking off a plan to move inference workloads to a reserved cluster model and we'd like a technical deep-dive with Redwood to align on pool sizing, autoscaling behavior, and isolation strategies (multi-tenant vs. dedicated per team).

High level:
- 30–50 concurrent sessions at p99 latency target 150ms for generation workloads
- Mixed seq lengths: 256 (70%) / 1024 (20%) / 2048 (10%)
- Need isolation for privacy-sensitive LLMs and tenant isolation for some partners

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute architecture review in the next two weeks? Our initial availability: May 24–26 (mornings PDT) or May 29 (afternoon PDT).

I've attached a short intake doc with current traffic patterns and two sample prompts. Happy to add any other context you need.

Attachments: nebula_capacity_intake.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Evan Brooks
Head of Platform
Nebula Systems

4) Isolation options and failure modes (15–20m)
5) Next steps & action items (10m)

To make the meeting productive please: attach any additional prompt sets, and confirm expected attendees on your side (engineers vs. product). Also let us know whether you prefer a 60 or 90 minute slot.

- Mon May 24: 9:00–11:30 PDT
